facts.text: Columbia Hills was deployed at Gusev Crater during Spirit (MER-A) in 2004.

Spirit drove 3 km to reach the Columbia Hills, named for the seven astronauts lost in the Space Shuttle Columbia disaster. The hills proved to be a scientific treasure: Spirit found evidence that water had once altered the rocks here. Minerals like goethite and hematite confirmed past water activity.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Contained rocks altered by water, including goethite (an iron mineral that only forms in the presence of water), proving Gusev Crater once had liquid water.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Gusev Crater.
The Columbia Hills remain a memorial to the seven Space Shuttle Columbia astronauts; Spirit's exploration showed their namesake hills held profound scientific secrets.
